findings.detail: The extracted cost sum exceeds the filing grand total and the schedule contains an intermediate affiliate-company subtotal among the investment rows.

rationale: The filing's March 31, 2026 schedule states total amortized cost of $5,916.273 million, independently echoed in the balance-sheet text, versus extracted cost of $6,240.417 million, an overstatement of $324.144 million (5.479%). The raw schedule includes an intermediate Total Non-Controlled/Affiliate Company Investments row, supporting subtotal leakage. The aggregate defect is decisive, although the available row structure does not prove that this single subtotal alone explains the exact residual.
